The instant Tr. Petition (Cr.) has been filed for transfer the case i.e. Sadar (Bara Bazar) P.S. Case No.256/2018 (G.R. No.1252 of 2018) registered under Section 498A/ 311 IPC from the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hazaribag to the judgeship of Gumla before any competent court.

2. The main ground on which the instant Tr. Petition (Crl.) has been filed is that at present the petitioner is living at Gumla which is her parents' house and it will not be convenient for her to appear before the court at Hazaribagh.
Further, one maintenance case is pending before the Court at Gumla and it will be convenient for her to appear in that case at Gumla.
3. Learned SPP for the State assisted by learned Opp. Party have opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that the maintenance case has already been disposed of and the Opp. Party No.2 is regularly paying Rs.4,000/- per month from his meagre income to the petitioner (wife).
A petition under Section 127 Cr.P.C. has been filed for enhancement of the maintenance amount.
It is submitted that out of nine charge-sheeted witnesses, only two witnesses are from the District of Gumla, but four witnesses are from Hazaribagh .

The normal place of enquiry and trial as per Chapter XXIII Cr.P.C. is that the place where incidence took place and in the present case, it is at Hazaribagh and only two witnesses are residents of Gumla.

4. It is submitted that it is a police case and there is no requirement for appearance of the petitioner on each and every date during trial of the case and her requirement will be there only on the date when her evidence is to be recorded by the learned court below.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and perusing the entire materials on record, this Court is of the considered view that no special circumstance is made out to transfer the case from Hazaribagh to Gumla.
Accordingly, I am not inclined to interfere with the prayer made in the instant petition.
Accordingly, the instant Tr. Petition (Crl.) is dismissed.

(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Sandeep/
